rice.name: Brown Planthopper
rice.symptoms: Yellowing and drying of plants, honeydew deposits
rice.treatment: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 125 ml/ha or use resistant varieties

rice.name: Blast Disease
rice.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions on leaves, neck rot
rice.treatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 600 g/ha, avoid excess nitrogen

rice.name: Stem Borer
rice.symptoms: Dead heart in vegetative stage, white ear in reproductive stage
rice.treatment: Apply Carbofuran 3G @ 25 kg/ha or light trap for adults

rice.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
rice.symptoms: Watery stripes on leaf margins turning yellow then brown
rice.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 3 g/litre, avoid waterlogging

wheat.name: Rust (Yellow/Brown)
wheat.symptoms: Orange or yellow powdery pustules on leaves
wheat.treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC @ 500 ml/ha at first appearance

wheat.name: Aphids
wheat.symptoms: Curling leaves, sticky honeydew, black sooty mould
wheat.treatment: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1 litre/ha or use natural enemies

wheat.name: Karnal Bunt
wheat.symptoms: Black powdery mass replacing grain, fishy smell
wheat.treatment: Treat seed with Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% @ 3 g/kg seed

wheat.name: Loose Smut
wheat.symptoms: Grains replaced by black powder, spike destruction
wheat.treatment: Hot water seed treatment at 52°C for 10 minutes

maize.name: Fall Armyworm
maize.symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves, sawdust-like frass in whorl
maize.treatment: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 400 g/ha into whorl

maize.name: Corn Borer
maize.symptoms: Holes in stem, dead heart, broken tassels
maize.treatment: Apply Chlorpyrifos granules @ 10 kg/ha in whorl

maize.name: Downy Mildew
maize.symptoms: White powdery growth on lower leaf surface, chlorosis
maize.treatment: Spray Metalaxyl 35 WS or Ridomil @ 2 g/litre

maize.name: Turcicum Blight
maize.symptoms: Large elliptical grey-green lesions with wavy margins
maize.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2 g/litre at 10-day intervals

cotton.name: Bollworm
cotton.symptoms: Holes in bolls, shedding of squares and bolls
cotton.treatment: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 160 ml/ha, use pheromone traps

cotton.name: Whitefly
cotton.symptoms: Yellowing leaves, virus transmission, honeydew deposits
cotton.treatment: Spray Acetamiprid 20 SP @ 200 g/ha, avoid broad-spectrum pesticides

cotton.name: Root Rot
cotton.treatment: Drench Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/litre, improve drainage

cotton.name: Jassids
cotton.symptoms: Leaf curl, yellowing from margins, stunted growth

banana.name: Panama Wilt
banana.symptoms: Yellowing of older leaves, brown vascular discolouration
banana.treatment: No chemical cure — use resistant varieties, soil solarisation

banana.name: Sigatoka Disease
banana.symptoms: Yellow streaks on leaves turning brown, leaf death
banana.treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/litre at 3-week intervals

banana.name: Banana Weevil
banana.symptoms: Tunnelling in corm, plant toppling, reduced yield
banana.treatment: Apply Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 50 ml per plant in soil

banana.name: Bunchy Top Virus
banana.symptoms: Small bunched leaves at top, dark green streaks on midrib
banana.treatment: No cure — rogue affected plants, control aphid vectors

sugarcane.name: Early Shoot Borer
sugarcane.symptoms: Dead heart in early stage, characteristic smell
sugarcane.treatment: Apply Chlorpyrifos granules @ 20 kg/ha, remove dead hearts

sugarcane.name: Red Rot
sugarcane.symptoms: Reddening of internal tissue with white patches, sour smell
sugarcane.treatment: Use disease-free setts, treat with Carbendazim @ 1 g/litre

sugarcane.name: Woolly Aphid
sugarcane.symptoms: White woolly masses on leaves and stems, yellowing
sugarcane.treatment: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 2 ml/litre or release Aphelinus parasitoid

sugarcane.name: Smut
sugarcane.symptoms: Black whip-like growth replacing the shoot
sugarcane.treatment: Hot water treatment of setts at 50°C for 2 hours

mango.name: Mango Hopper
mango.symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck sap from inflorescences
mango.treatment: Spray Imidacloprid 200 SL @ 0.5 ml/litre before flowering

mango.name: Powdery Mildew
mango.symptoms: White powdery coating on flowers, fruits and leaves
mango.treatment: Spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 3 g/litre or Carbendazim

mango.name: Anthracnose
mango.symptoms: Dark spots on fruits, flowers, and leaves; fruit rot
mango.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/litre during flowering

mango.name: Fruit Fly
mango.symptoms: Maggots inside fruit, premature fruit drop
mango.treatment: Use methyl eugenol traps, collect and destroy fallen fruits

tomato.name: Early Blight
tomato.symptoms: Dark concentric rings on lower leaves, defoliation
tomato.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/litre every 7-10 days

tomato.name: Fruit Borer
tomato.symptoms: Circular holes in fruits, frass deposits
tomato.treatment: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 160 ml/ha, use pheromone traps

tomato.name: Leaf Curl Virus
tomato.symptoms: Upward rolling of leaves, yellowing, stunted growth
tomato.treatment: No cure — control whitefly vectors with Imidacloprid

tomato.name: Bacterial Wilt
tomato.symptoms: Sudden wilting, vascular browning, bacterial ooze
tomato.treatment: Soil solarisation, crop rotation, avoid waterlogging

chickpea.name: Pod Borer
chickpea.symptoms: Larvae bore into pods, flowers and stems
chickpea.treatment: Spray Indoxacarb 14.5 SC @ 500 ml/ha at pod formation

chickpea.name: Wilt
chickpea.symptoms: Sudden wilting of plants, brown vascular discolouration
chickpea.treatment: Use resistant varieties, treat seed with Trichoderma @ 4 g/kg

chickpea.name: Blight
chickpea.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions, girdling of stem, plant death
chickpea.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/litre, avoid wet conditions

chickpea.name: Aphids
chickpea.symptoms: Curling of terminal shoots, yellowing, honeydew
chickpea.treatment: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 2 ml/litre or Neem oil @ 5 ml/litre

default.name: Aphids
default.treatment: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 2 ml/litre or Neem oil @ 5 ml/litre

default.name: Fungal Leaf Spot
default.symptoms: Circular brown spots on leaves with yellow halo
default.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/litre every 10 days

default.name: Whitefly
default.symptoms: White insects under leaves, yellowing, virus spread
default.treatment: Spray Acetamiprid 20 SP @ 200 g/ha, use yellow sticky traps

default.name: Root Rot
default.treatment: Improve drainage, drench Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/litre
